Federal ICP — Renewal of residence permits (includes student and sponsor/host grace-period categories)
sources.note: Official ICP renewal service page. It lists a 180-day grace period for students after completing their studies and a 60-day grace period for residence permits issued with a guarantor or host. These are separate categories; verify the applicant's exact permit, sponsor, emirate and circumstances. Page last updated 12 November 2026 when checked. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: Department of Home Affairs — Student visa application rule changes (subclasses 500 & 590)
sources.note: Official change notice. Review the 2 October 2026 commencement date, onshore application eligibility, subsequent Student visa applications and family-member inclusion rules. Detection is not legal interpretation; verify affected applicant category and exceptions against the current legislation before counselling.

sources.name: Federal Register — Migration Amendment (Student Visa Reform) Regulations 2026 (F2026L01347)
sources.note: Primary legislative instrument registered 1 October 2026; commenced 2 October 2026. Review exact scope, application dates, exceptions and transitional provisions.

European Commission — Student visas in Europe
German Embassy Colombo — Students (national visa)
German Embassy Colombo — Long-stay national visa requirements
Department of Home Affairs — Student visa condition 8105 (work limitation)
sources.note: Primary official condition page. Verify the visa grant notice and VEVO for the individual applicant; current published guidance describes the 48-hours-per-fortnight limit, exceptions and course-session rules. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — Work off campus as an international student (24-hour weekly limit)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; counsellors must manually review current 24-hour limit, DLI/full-time eligibility, programme start, scheduled breaks and permit conditions.

sources.name: IRCC — Proof of financial support (living-cost table)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; manually verify the current application-date threshold, family size, Quebec rules, tuition/travel exclusion and source-of-funds evidence.

sources.name: Make it in Germany — Visa for studying (2026 funds and student work)
sources.note: Federal Government guidance: check current blocked-account amount and student work limits; distinguish study visa from visa to seek a place and verify individual residence conditions.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Working on a student visa
sources.note: Official student work eligibility and conditions; 25-hour limit applies only where the student's visa and course conditions permit it. Verify eVisa/visa letter.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Changes to student visas (27 October 2026)
sources.note: Official INZ announcement of changes effective 27 October 2026: master's-by-research work-rights change for new applications, English-language ability as a key factor, broader processing suspension grounds, and extension of relevant post-course expiry period from 1 month to 2 months. Check application-date scope and current visa conditions; detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — PAL/TAL requirements, exemptions and validity (2026)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; manual review required for 2026 PAL/TAL cap-year validity, public DLI degree-granting master's/doctoral exemption from 1 January 2026, Quebec CAQ, school/level changes and other exceptions. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — Post-graduation work permit eligibility
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify PGWP-eligible DLI and exact programme, programme length, full-time history, 180-day application window, language thresholds, field-of-study/CIP requirement by study-permit application date, 2026 eligible-field list freeze, public-private partnership exclusions, distance learning, transfers and leave exceptions. Obtain the exact 6-digit CIP code in writing from the DLI and cross-check against IRCC. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — PGWP field of study and eligible CIP codes
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. IRCC states the eligible-field list is frozen for 2026; manually verify exact 6-digit CIP 2021 code, applicant's study permit/PGWP application dates and any grandfathering against the live official list. Do not infer eligibility from a programme title.

sources.name: IRCC — Designated learning institutions list and PGWP-eligible programme details
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify exact institution, DLI number, province/campus, PGWP-eligible DLI list and exact programme details. IRCC explicitly states not all programmes at a listed DLI qualify. Cross-check all general PGWP, language and field-of-study requirements. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: UK Home Office — Register of licensed sponsors: Students
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify legal sponsor name, Student sponsor category, rating and current licence status close to application; confirm exact course/CAS and sponsor remains licensed. The register was updated 11 November 2026 when checked.

sources.name: GOV.UK — Student visa: course requirements and CAS
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify exact course level, mode, study location, approved qualification, ATAS if applicable, CAS details and 6-month application window. Do not treat an offer as a CAS.

sources.name: Australian Government — CRICOS registration
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify provider and exact course CRICOS registration, campus/location, course code and registration dates; provider registration alone does not establish every course/campus is registered.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Rules for approved education providers and Code signatories
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify provider's current Code of Practice signatory status through NZQA and exact programme/campus; international students cannot study at a non-signatory institution. Provider status is not visa approval.

sources.name: Dubai Government — Student Residence Visa
sources.note: Official Dubai Government overview. Manually verify the exact institution, host/guarantor, campus, study programme and current GDRFA route. Institution host/guarantor status is not automatic for every course or provider.

sources.name: Visit Dubai — Apply for a student visa
sources.note: Dubai's official destination portal explains the institution-managed GDRFA process and typical applicant documents. Treat as guidance; confirm exact requirements and fees through the institution and GDRFA for the applicant's case.

sources.name: Federal ICP — Issuing residency permit (student conditions and documents)
sources.note: Official ICP service page. It lists student-specific documents, programme-based residence duration and a 180-day stay after completion of the study period. Do not conflate with GDRFA Dubai's 60-day statement after expiry/cancellation; confirm emirate, permit category and circumstances.

sources.name: MoHRE — Cabinet Resolution / Executive Regulations (student training and employment permit category)
sources.note: Official MoHRE-hosted executive regulations identify a student training and employment permit category for students already in the UAE, subject to conditions and employer approval. Verify current permit process, employer jurisdiction and eligibility before any work begins.

sources.name: GDRFA Dubai — Issuing a visit visa for study, training or rehabilitation
sources.note: Separate single-entry 30/60/180-day study or training visit-visa route. Verify host letter, passport validity, purpose, duration, extension and live fees. Do not confuse with student residence permit.
